content:
BUILT CoLAB presents here one of its associates, Mota-Engil.

Founded in 1946, the Mota-Engil Group is currently a multinational whose activity is centred on the construction and management of infrastructure in the areas of Engineering and Construction, Environment and Services, Transport Concessions, Energy and Mining.

It is a market leader in Portugal and holds a consolidated position in the ranking of the 25 largest European construction groups.

Mota-Engil has a presence in 25 countries, spread across Europe, Africa and Latin America, maintaining in each market the same standards of rigour, quality and execution capacity that have established Mota-Engil internationally.

Its history is marked by a culture of entrepreneurship and innovation in the permanent pursuit of new horizons, which is why it holds stakes in more than 200 companies.

Mota-Engil always seeks to achieve a market position aligned with best practices and business conduct based on ethical principles, supported by a unique and integrated strategic vision for the future: a Group that is more international, innovative and competitive on a global scale.
